column3: “Courts” specifies temple; teaching is rendered as the purpose of sitting down.
BSB’s “to Him” matches the Textus Receptus (αὐτὸν); “in the midst” becomes “before them.” The Greek has present “bring.”
BSB’s “Jesus” and “standing” match the Textus Receptus (Ἰησοῦς); the critical text has neither the name nor the verb of standing.
BSB’s “your accusers” matches the Textus Receptus (κατήγοροί); the critical text has only “where are they?”
“Valid” renders true; the Greek ends with present “where I come from,” rather than “where I came from.”
“I and the Father” is recast as “I am with the Father.”
“In the treasury” becomes “near the treasury”; “courts” specifies temple.
“But” replaces the conjunction and before dying.
